title: A Rule of Property for Bengal: An Essay on the Idea of Permanent Settlement
seoTitle: A Rule of Property for Bengal - Permanent Settlement Source
seoDescription: Ranajit Guha's major academic study of the ideological and administrative making of the Permanent Settlement in Bengal.
note: Major academic study of the intellectual, administrative, and property-rights logic behind the Permanent Settlement in Bengal.
whyItMatters: It is a landmark scholarly source for understanding the Permanent Settlement as a property regime, not just a revenue measure.
